hook.name: JITRangeHook
hook.description: A sole-operator JIT liquidity hook that prices each swap via an internal quote engine, then injects a single-sided one-tick liquidity range at a computed effective price tick in beforeSwap and removes it in afterSwap, enforcing full fill and window-based notional caps. Blocks third-party LPs via beforeAddLiquidity revert; requires operator to push prices off-chain and fund inventory as ERC-6909 claims.
